# Icon Reference Sheet

Source: [6460](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/6460); edited 2025-07-13. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-6460-n1"></a>

- Catalog spans Create Icon, Icon String, Ability Icon String, Hero Icon String and additional in-game icons unavailable to Workshop; distinguish visual existence from API availability.

<a id="wiki-6460-n2"></a>

- Ability Icon String takes a raw hero value, so icons do not automatically change with player alternate form; examples include Bastion, D.Va and Ramattra.

<a id="wiki-6460-n3"></a>

- Editor marks unavailable icons (*), form-invariant alternatives (**), wrong button placements (??), missing site assets and buttons rendering nothing (omitted entirely).

<a id="wiki-6460-n4"></a>

- Per-hero tables map primary/secondary/ability/ultimate/melee/jump/crouch buttons to icons, including passive icons marked unavailable and nonstandard mappings such as Baptiste Exo Boots/Wrecking Ball Piledriver on Crouch.

<a id="wiki-6460-n5"></a>

- Wrong-placement markers include Pharah Jump and Zenyatta melee/passive; retain annotation rather than treating all rows as valid API requests.

Data: [normalized factual tables](../tables/6460.md).

Source limitations:

- July 2025 catalog incomplete for current heroes and contains reworked abilities such as Cassidy Magnetic Grenade.

- Malformed extra/missing table columns require careful normalization.

- Site [ability ...]/[hero ...] renderers are not Workshop syntax or evidence that API supports those icons.

- Images not viewed; complete textual catalog read.
